settings.text:
1. Sign in with your XTB work email. We send you a one-time code, so there is no password to remember.
  2. Pick your swag. Choose a product, size and colour, and add it to your cart. Prices are shown in XTB Coins.
  3. Go to checkout and enter your delivery address. Shipping is free, worldwide.
  4. Enter your voucher code in the Discount code or gift card field and click Apply.
  5. Place your order. You will get an order confirmation by email, and a shipping notice once it is on its way.

Good to know

  • Checkout shows prices in US dollars: 1 XTB Coin = $1.
  • Your voucher works once. Any value you don't use in that order is lost, so make the most of it.
  • If your cart costs more than your voucher, checkout asks you to pay the difference by card.
  • Vouchers are valid for 1 year from the day you receive them.
